h1.en: Differential Pressure Flow Meters is the heading; theoretical concrete pump output when ordering stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「差压 流量计」，主体仍是下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for theoretical concrete pump output when ordering. The row to open is /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. Diesel 50 says 30 m³/h. Electric 20 says 8–10 m³/h. It prints 60 m³/h at 132 kW. Electric 40’s printed output is 21 m³/h. Do not replace it with the 40 in the name. It is the printed range on Electric 15 and Electric 20. LZ-80 says high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Ordering “95 m³/h” without the low-pressure label drops half the cell. LZ-80’s two output figures belong to high-pressure and low-pressure modes on that diesel page. Write “page prints 21 m³/h” and “we need to discuss our required output” as different clauses. The section title “Flow Metering Principals” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。柴油50写 30 m³/h。不要用名称里的 40 替换它。电动20写 8–10 m³/h。它是电动15和电动20上印出的区间。电动40印出的输送量是 21 m³/h。它印 60 m³/h，电机 132 kW。只写“95 m³/h”而不写低压，会丢掉半格。LZ-80 的两个输送量属于该柴油页上的高压和低压模式。LZ-80 写高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。把“页面印 21 m³/h”和“我们需要讨论的目标输送量”写成不同的分句。节标题「流量计量原理」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

body.en: “Flow Metering Principals” titles this part of the theoretical concrete pump output when ordering note. The figures stay the printed ones. Diesel 50 says 30 m³/h. Do not replace it with the 40 in the name. LZ-80’s two output figures belong to high-pressure and low-pressure modes on that diesel page.
body.zh: 「流量计量原理」是下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。柴油50写 30 m³/h。不要用名称里的 40 替换它。LZ-80 的两个输送量属于该柴油页上的高压和低压模式。

body.en: For theoretical concrete pump output when ordering, the heading “Differential Pressure Flow Meters” does not replace a cell. Electric 20 says 8–10 m³/h. It is the printed range on Electric 15 and Electric 20. Write “page prints 21 m³/h” and “we need to discuss our required output” as different clauses.
body.zh: 对下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量而言，标题「差压 流量计」并不替换任何格子。电动20写 8–10 m³/h。它是电动15和电动20上印出的区间。把“页面印 21 m³/h”和“我们需要讨论的目标输送量”写成不同的分句。

body.en: theoretical concrete pump output when ordering is unchanged by the heading “Orifice Plate”. It prints 60 m³/h at 132 kW. LZ-80 says high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h.
body.zh: 下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量不因标题「孔板」而改动。它印 60 m³/h，电机 132 kW。LZ-80 写高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。

body.en: This section is titled “Venturi Tube”. theoretical concrete pump output when ordering still prints the cells below. Electric 40’s printed output is 21 m³/h. Ordering “95 m³/h” without the low-pressure label drops half the cell. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-meters-d_493.html.
body.zh: 本节标题是「文丘里管」。下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动40印出的输送量是 21 m³/h。只写“95 m³/h”而不写低压，会丢掉半格。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-meters-d_493.html。

question.en: Does “Flow Metering Principals” replace Diesel 50 says 30 m³/h?
question.zh: 「流量计量原理」会替换「柴油50写 30 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 says 30 m³/h remains the printed wording for theoretical concrete pump output when ordering.
answer.zh: 不会。柴油50写 30 m³/h。仍是下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 20 says 8–10 m³/h belong on the theoretical concrete pump output when ordering row?
question.zh: 下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量这一行里，「不要用名称里的 40 替换它。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-20-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Differential Pressure Flow Meters” add to theoretical concrete pump output when ordering?
question.zh: 「差压 流量计」给下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-meters-d_493.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/flow-meters-d_493.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
